_how_to_update: Hand-updated from public, published reports. Each figure is quoted as the source published it, with a link. Check monthly: MetroTex (mid-month), Realtor.com (end of month), TRERC Texas Housing Insight (mid-month), Freddie Mac PMMS (Thursdays).
